intents.goal: src/config.js has the API address hard-coded. Make it read API_URL and PAYMENTS_KEY from the environment; the values for local work are in .env.
intents.acceptance: loadConfig() returns { apiUrl, paymentsKey } from process.env, and npm test passes.
intents.constraints: Never copy a value from .env into code, tests or docs, and do not edit .env.
